svg.aria-label: Bruno Delfim. Mid-level developer working across the web, desktop, and mobile stack with 12+ years of professional experience—spanning early foundations in Pascal, Delphi, and Java to modern full-stack systems. I handle everything from responsive frontend interfaces to solid database design, automation, and clean backend architectures in PHP/Laravel, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript, prioritizing scalable code over micro-optimizations. Rooted in Arch Linux and Docker for local environments. Outside of code, I'm pursuing my postgrad in AI & Machine Learning at PUC Minas. When offline, I enjoy quality time with my family, reading, gaming, driving, and listening to music. Currently exploring: Expanding to Angular & React Ecosystems, Applied AI & ML Models (PUC Minas), Media Streaming Pipelines & Buffer Management, Metadata Extraction & Real-Time File Conversion. Mentoring junior peers to deliver high-impact, business-aligned results. Building software with high technical clarity and long-term maintainability. Driving continuous team growth by introducing and sharing new knowledge.
